record.definition: unit-size-adjusted median resale $psf, Sep 2021–Sep 2023 against Oct 2024–Sep 2026

text.price: $2,300 psf, the median resale price over the last 24 months (Oct 2024 to Sep 2026).
text.comparison: Resale prices are in line with similar developments in District 15.
text.record: Prices rose 17% between 2021–23 and 2024–26 (adjusted for unit size), against about 16% for developments with similar features in District 15 — about the same as similar developments.
infrastructure: Tanjong Katong MRT, about 240 m (straight line to the nearest exit).
Tanjong Katong Primary School, about 380 m: 1.6 applicants per place in Phase 2C, 2025. Admission depends on the exact address.
supply: 10 developments within 2 km are still selling, with about 196 unsold homes (URA developers' sales, Sep 2026).
text.demand: 36 resales in the last 24 months, in 19 of 24 months.
watch: Resale prices in 2021–23 started well above the district.
text.answer: Right by an MRT station and a popular primary school within 1 km. Resale prices are in line with similar developments in District 15.
